scope.date_basis: User identified match 1 as 2026-11-14 and matches 2-11 as the course window. Exports contain simulation clocks, not reliable wall-clock match timestamps.

rating_reconciliation.note: All 11 outcomes, public match_end events and supplied per-match screenshots agree. The dashboard 55% cannot be reconciled from these 11 results; the cause is unverified. Do not subtract one match score to recompute OpenSkill or claim a course-only platform rating.

v1_assessment.recommendation: Upload the existing V1 as a narrowly scoped next experiment. It does not fix navigation, repeated patrol switching, arrival handling or seat delays. No win-rate benefit has yet been measured.

metric_definitions.tolerance: Recorded V0 action comparison uses 1e-12 absolute/relative float tolerance.
metric_definitions.memory_loss: Defender alive in live phase, a planted position previously legally observed with the same fuse, but position now omitted.
metric_definitions.premature_patrol_flip: Moving policy changes between static sites after the timer bucket changed, while more than 5m from the old goal. 5m is an analysis threshold.
metric_definitions.escape: Reconstructed V0 escape_until increases; not synonymous with a proven collision.
metric_definitions.near_zero_xy_motion: A move was requested in an alive live-phase callback, but horizontal displacement to the next 3-tick observation was <=0.005m.
metric_definitions.duration: Simulation seconds, not wall time or CPU time.
metric_definitions.v1_check: V0/V1 receive the same recorded V0 observations. This is action regression, not an engine replay or counterfactual match.
